audience: managers of hourly and shift-based teams who schedule and track staff in Connecteam

useCases.title: See who is scheduled to work on a day
useCases.text: The AI lists the shifts of a scheduler in a time window with assigned users, job, location and published state, and maps user ids to names.

useCases.title: Total the hours worked this week
useCases.text: The AI reads timesheet totals of a time clock per user and day, with work and break hours and approval flags. It adds up hours per employee.

useCases.title: Check clock-in records and time off requests
useCases.text: The AI reads clock-in and clock-out records for up to 31 days, and lists time-off requests in a date range with policy type and status. You see who worked and who is away.

useCases.title: Create a shift for an employee
useCases.text: The AI creates one shift in a scheduler for one user or one open spot. It is a draft by default, so employees see nothing until it is published.

useCases.title: Assign a quick task on a task board
useCases.text: The AI creates a task on a task board for chosen users, as a draft or published to their apps. It can read the labels of the board first.
